## Summary
- Aux bus return fader on the Monitor strip (drag Y; double-click → unity)
- `set_aux_return` / snap `aux_return` via Aux `gain_control`
- `--smoke-aux-return`: ensure Aux → 0.5 → 1.0 unity (Dummy exit 0)

## Test plan
- [x] `win_ardour\run-engine-shell.bat --backend Dummy --smoke-aux-return --timeout 25 --no-splash` → EXIT=0
title: Expose Aux bus return gain beside the monitor strip
